name: Doja | 1g Pre-Roll | Giraffe Puzzy
description:
Zkittlez x Animal Cookies

Smells of tropical fruit compliment a candy gas finish and add a level of complexity to this potent Z cross. The flavor is an extension of the smell and can be described as a progression of traditional Z candy fruit with hints of menthol and Mountain Dew soda before finishing in a sharp and pungent petroleum. The effect is strong and lasting but without the lethargic heaviness.
